praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being…

Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
